narrative.overview:
Warm charcoal frames paper panels with strong, compact headlines and precise engineering diagrams. Visible neighboring panels establish sequence; generous interior space keeps each decision readable. Supporting work uses quiet ruled rows, while full cases use a paper reading surface.

This records the implemented, user-approved option C. The mockup establishes composition; the source and final review captures establish tokens and behavior. The numbered four-stop selector remains functional navigation; duplicated labels above panel titles were removed during finish review.
keyCharacteristics: Paper and charcoal surfaces with amber state cues.
Wix headlines, Plex prose, and Plex Mono diagrams.
Native scrolling, visible neighbors, and direct case links.
Flat surfaces and bounded diagram motion.

rules.name: The Surface Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use ink text and the darker focus color on paper; use paper text and amber focus on charcoal.

rules.name: The Role Separation Rule
rules.body: Reserve Wix for case and section headlines; keep prose in Plex Sans and process labels in Plex Mono.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep paper panels and supporting rows shadow-free; use surface contrast and rules for separation.

dos: Do keep native vertical scrolling and visible neighboring panels.
Do preserve semantic case links, keyboard focus and static content without JavaScript.
Do use self-hosted fonts and assets under the existing content security policy.
Do keep diagram motion bounded and provide the complete static reduced-motion state.
Do allow Brazilian Portuguese labels and prose to wrap.
donts: Don't reintroduce duplicate eyebrows above case titles.
Don't treat the functional numbered case selector as a decorative label style.
Don't add looping animation, scroll hijacking or shadow-based elevation.
Don't use portraits, private employer artifacts or invented evidence.
